t: Yachid shello hitpallel en chabero motzio
s: Yachid shello hitpallel en chabero motzio ubo seip echad: ap al pi shebbet' berakot shel musap rosh hashshana ap habbaqi yotze bitpillat hashsheliach tzibbur kemo shennitbaer besiman tqtz"a, mikkol maqom im en sham tisha sheonin amen achar birkotayv — en adam yotze bitpillato, apillu mi sheeno baqi veeno yodea lehitpallel beatzmo. Vaapillu im hu beinyan sheen tzarik laanot amen achar birkotayv, kegon sheadayin lo hitpallel tepillat musap belachash, venimtza shehu tzarik lehitpallel bishbil atzmo belachash, ella shehu mitpallel beqol kede lehotzi gam et sheeno baqi, venimtza deap im lo yaanu amen achar birkotayv en kan chashash beraka lebattala, ap al pi ken im en tisha sheonin amen — en tepillato niqret tepillat hatztzibbur, veen adam yotze yede chobato bishmia ella im ken shomea tepillat hatztzibbur, lepi shekkak hayeta hattaqqana battechilla keshettiqqenu tepillat hatztzibbur, sheyyachazir hashsheliach tzibbur et hattepilla beqol ram kede lehotzi mi sheeno baqi, veim eno mitpallel tepillat hatztzibbur eno yakol lehotzi acherim bitpillato, shehattepilla enah kishar berakot sheadam yotze yede chobato bishmia vaaniyyat amen, abal bitpilla tzarik kol echad veechad lebaqqesh rachamim, veen nakon lebaqqesh al yede shaliach ella im ken hu sheliach tzibbur. Abal bitqiot yakol adam latzet bishmia apillu hu yodea litqoa beatzmo, vaapillu im en sham tzibbur sheyyishmeu immo:
